**/*.test.*, **/test/**, **/tests/**, pa.everyfield/resend-senders: Tests drive fake mail providers, and early access is one of the guarded senders that may reach Resend

tests/integration/**, tests/evry/**, tes.typescript/no-explicit-any: No typecheck covers these test folders, so a type written there goes unchecked; any marks untyped JSON
tests/integration/**, tests/evry/**, tes.no-unused-vars: Tests drop fields with rest destructuring to compare what is left

tests/**/*.cjs.typescript/no-require-imports: A CommonJS preload that node loads with --require can only require

packages/domain/src/intelligence/**.everyfield/private-care-scope: The intelligence domain owns the private-care tables and operations

packages/domain/src/operations/refusals..everyfield/domain-refusals: defineRefusals lives here: it builds the one refusal class, the retry table read from the contract and the refusal reply every domain module uses

packages/domain/src/feedback/index.ts.everyfield/domain-refusals: Feedback refusals are a bare { code } that Evry and the feedback screens read; defineRefusals adds details, correlationId and retry, which would change what Evry sees

packages/domain/src/dashboard/index.ts.everyfield/domain-refusals: Dashboard refusals are a bare { code } that Evry and the dashboard read; defineRefusals adds details, correlationId and retry, which would change what Evry sees

packages/domain/src/people/pipeline-metr.everyfield/domain-refusals: Pipeline metrics answers a bare { code } refusal that its contract test pins; defineRefusals adds details, correlationId and retry to that reply

packages/domain/src/identity/**.everyfield/domain-refusals: Identity uses another mechanism: an identity refusal carries its HTTP status and identity's handler answers it as HTTP JSON; an invitation refusal carries a parsed safe error with retryAt details

packages/domain/src/settings/credentials.everyfield/domain-refusals: Credential changes answer identity's credential outcome (a status with a correlationId and no retry), the same mechanism as identity's password and email flows

packages/domain/src/organizations/seat.t.everyfield/domain-refusals: Organization pipeline, program and import refusals use another mechanism: a { status, refusal } reply whose refusal carries a field or file problem beside its code

packages/domain/src/organizations/core.t.everyfield/domain-refusals: Organization commands refuse with a typed code (OrganizationRefusal) that the web mount and Evry each turn into their own reply; organizations has no safe-error contract to define refusals from

packages/domain/src/people/csv/sheet.ts.everyfield/domain-refusals: SheetRefused carries a file problem that People CSV import and the organizations pipeline import each turn into their own module's refusal; it never reaches a reply itself

ignorePatterns..next/**: Next writes its build and dev output here; it is not source
ignorePatterns.out/**: Next writes a static export here; it is build output, not source
ignorePatterns.build/**: Build output that tools write; it is not source
ignorePatterns.next-env.d.ts: Next generates this file and it is not committed
